items.title: TensorFold recipes for Qwen3.8-27B, Flash Next and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt land in Omarchy's local AI catalogue
items.summary: TensorFold recipes for Qwen3.8-27B, Flash Next and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt are now in the omarchy-local-ai catalogue, so Omarchy Linux users can pick an optimized local runtime recipe for those models. DHH quoted the post and said TensorFold will anchor the project's local AI recipes for out-of-the-box agents on NVIDIA.
